exam.title: Developing AI-Enabled Database Solutions
exam.study_prerequisites: T-SQL development, relational and JSON design, Microsoft SQL platforms, security, performance tuning, Git and CI/CD, APIs and change processing, plus model, embedding, vector search, and RAG fundamentals.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Secure, optimize, and deploy database solutions
Implement AI capabilities in database solutions

review.notes: All three March 12, 2026 objective groups and every published subobjective are mapped to requirement, platform, implementation, evidence, failure, and recovery decisions. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original knowledge checks cover relational, specialized and JSON design; current T-SQL; AI-assisted tools and MCP; layered security; concurrency and tuning; SQL database projects and controlled deployment; Data API builder; monitoring and change processing; external models; embedding lifecycle; vectors, ENN/ANN and hybrid retrieval; and secure RAG. All 86 cited URLs are exact catalog entries: 84 were reachable and two commercial-provider pages were access-blocked; none was missing or broken. The guide marks platform and preview volatility, current Microsoft Foundry naming, vector-index tooling limits, and the August 2026 CES Event Hubs transition. No upcoming blueprint change or exam retirement was announced.

findings.title: Live October objectives retain CES
findings.evidence: The currently published change-mechanism objective includes CES; earlier broad-sweep removal wording is no longer supported.
findings.recommendation: Correct guide and maintenance action; retain accepted March snapshot.
findings.resolution: Correct guide and maintenance action; retain accepted March snapshot.

findings.title: Language availability expanded
findings.evidence: Current credential lists ten languages, 120 minutes.
findings.recommendation: Replace English-only statement and retain language-specific recheck.
findings.resolution: Replace English-only statement and retain language-specific recheck.

findings.title: RLS writes need an update block
findings.evidence: A filter and AFTER INSERT block do not prevent moving an existing visible row to another tenant.
findings.recommendation: Add AFTER UPDATE block and original tenant 7-to-8 example with denied-update lab.
findings.resolution: Add AFTER UPDATE block and original tenant 7-to-8 example with denied-update lab.

findings.title: Session context is not authenticated identity
findings.evidence: Any user can set their own session context; read_only freezes a value without validating its initial provenance.
findings.recommendation: Require trusted validated identity, restricted direct DB access and connection initialization.
findings.resolution: Require trusted validated identity, restricted direct DB access and connection initialization.

findings.title: DAB 2.0 changes authentication and inheritance defaults
findings.evidence: New Unauthenticated configuration ignores JWTs; role inheritance and OBO have explicit scope/cache requirements.
findings.recommendation: Add default, one-role inheritance, autoentity, OBO and runtime-cache boundaries; lab and answers.
findings.resolution: Add default, one-role inheritance, autoentity, OBO and runtime-cache boundaries; lab and answers.

findings.title: Claim propagation must match the RLS predicate
findings.evidence: The SQL session-context option and claim keys must match the identity contract; a preferred_username example is not a tenant_id mapping.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit claim/predicate contract and negative test.
findings.resolution: Add explicit claim/predicate contract and negative test.

findings.title: Expired progress requires reconciliation
findings.evidence: A saved version older than minimum valid version cannot enumerate a complete retained change set; validation/enumeration need a consistent snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Add 12/15/20 example, baseline/deletion reconciliation and transaction scope.
findings.resolution: Add 12/15/20 example, baseline/deletion reconciliation and transaction scope.

findings.title: CES target names and retirement differ by platform
findings.evidence: Azure SQL/Fabric use AzureEventHubs for new groups; SQL Server/MI retain ApacheKafka name pending update; existing AMQP groups end in April 2027.
findings.recommendation: Clarify names, drain/migration risks and month-only deadline; add two follow-ups.
findings.resolution: Clarify names, drain/migration risks and month-only deadline; add two follow-ups.

findings.title: SQL trigger retries can stop tracking a row
findings.evidence: Current documentation says five consecutive function failures cause that row to be ignored for future changes; polling coalesces repeated changes.
findings.recommendation: Add reconciliation/monitoring and version-specific recovery, without inventing a dead-letter queue or command.
findings.resolution: Add reconciliation/monitoring and version-specific recovery, without inventing a dead-letter queue or command.

findings.title: External model objects currently support embeddings
findings.evidence: CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL currently supports MODEL_TYPE EMBEDDINGS.
findings.recommendation: Remove completion-model object claim and separate completion application/REST calls.
findings.resolution: Remove completion-model object claim and separate completion application/REST calls.

findings.title: Chunk size is character-based
findings.evidence: FIXED chunk length is characters and overlap is a percentage, not model tokens.

findings.title: Embedding maintenance needs a version contract
findings.evidence: Generation is external work; an old worker result can arrive after source text or required model changes.
findings.recommendation: Replace hot synchronous update example with conditional source-hash/model write; preserve deletion and stale-result reconciliation.
findings.resolution: Replace hot synchronous update example with conditional source-hash/model write; preserve deletion and stale-result reconciliation.

findings.title: Vector dimension documentation differs
findings.evidence: Release notes describe float16 preview up to 3996, while datatype documentation gives 1998.
findings.recommendation: Preserve conservative shared bound and explicit engine/base-type/build/driver verification; schedule clarification.
findings.resolution: Preserve conservative shared bound and explicit engine/base-type/build/driver verification; schedule clarification.

findings.title: Approximation permission does not force an ANN plan
findings.evidence: Current VECTOR_SEARCH can select exact search or fall back without a compatible ANN index; latest index/query forms have platform-specific constraints.
findings.recommendation: Clarify v3 scope, DML/filter behavior and plan verification; add authorized recall and deterministic exact baseline.
findings.resolution: Clarify v3 scope, DML/filter behavior and plan verification; add authorized recall and deterministic exact baseline.

findings.title: SQL security does not automatically secure mirrored copies
findings.evidence: RLS, masking and sensitivity labels do not propagate to mirrored OneLake data; columnstore tables have mirroring limitations.
findings.recommendation: Separate source SQL controls, copied-data permissions and Fabric table/index support.
findings.resolution: Separate source SQL controls, copied-data permissions and Fabric table/index support.

findings.title: REST success needs application-level validation
findings.evidence: Credential REFERENCES permission, redirect restrictions and HTTP/body outcomes matter beyond SQL execution.
findings.recommendation: Add permission and status/body boundaries and answered checks.
findings.resolution: Add permission and status/body boundaries and answered checks.
